# Milecrew

> Milecrew GmbH is a software crew from Cologne, Germany. It provides consulting and interim CTO services, develops software products in pragmatic milestones and operates them – simply good software.

The website is available in English and German. Job postings are published in
German only. Contact: hello@milecrew.com, Gürzenichstrasse 21a-c,
50667 Cologne, Germany.

## Pages (English)

- [Milecrew](https://www.milecrew.com/en/): Simply Good Software
- [About Us](https://www.milecrew.com/en/about-us/): More Than a Team: We Are Milecrew.
- [Our Concept](https://www.milecrew.com/en/cto-concept/): Milecrew’s Holistic CTO Approach: Consulting, Technology & Organization
- [Jobs](https://www.milecrew.com/en/jobs/): Join the Crew, working at Milecrew
- [Contact](https://www.milecrew.com/en/contact/): We are your project crew – contact us.
